    About the Project

    The product enables users to create content using AI-generated avatars and influencers that can produce media on the user's behalf. The project is currently actively scaling.

    The QA Engineer will play a key role in owning product quality, improving QA processes, and introducing AI-assisted testing practices where they bring real value.

    • 5+ years of professional QA experience, with a strong focus on manual testing

    AI-First Senior QA Engineer (Manual)

    Ukraine, Kyiv · On-Site · Full-Time

     

    Company: Orbox.ai - AI-Native PropTech Operating System for Real Estate

     

    Location: Ukraine, Kyiv  on-site, office in the city centre

    Employment: Full-time, permanent

    Seniority: Senior

    Reports to: Technical Lead 

    Works with: Product Analyst, Product Designer, Engineering team, Fleet of Agents

    PropTech experience: Not essential; very good if you have direct or indirect experience

    English: Advanced (B2+)

     

    About

    We are building an AI-native operating system for real estate. The product is a PropTech platform where LLMs and AI agents are not bolted on top - they are the architecture. Owners, operators and guests interact with the AI system through natural language. AI autonomously generates compliance documents, routes staff, answers guest queries from a RAG-indexed knowledge base in real time and orchestrates financial split-payments.

     

    But the product is only half of it.

     

    We are equally an AI-first delivery organization. The way we discover, define and ship is as differentiated as what we ship. Specs, stories and designs are machine-readable artifacts our coding and review agents consume directly — and quality is verified by a human who knows exactly where agents fail, where specs lie and where the product breaks in real hands.

     

    The role

    This is the role that decides whether what we ship actually works  for humans and for the agents that built it.

     

    You will report directly to the Head of Delivery & Product, with short decision loops to founders and direct access to engineering.

     

    This is a hands-on, manual-first QA role at the core of the delivery machine. Most of our code is written by AI agents against machine-readable specs. That makes human quality judgment more valuable, not less: agents pass their own checks and still ship broken flows, wrong edge-case behaviour and UX that technically matches the spec but fails the user. You are the last honest reader of the product before it reaches staging review and then customers on prod.

     

    You will own manual testing end to end: exploratory testing, spec-based test design, UAT coordination, regression passes and release sign-off. You will test not just deterministic UI flows, but AI-driven behaviour  agent responses, RAG answers, document generation  where “expected result” is a judgment call, not an assert.

     

    You will work side by side with the AI-First Product Analyst (who writes the specs you test against) and engineering (whose agents implement them). You will use our shared Claude Team / Cowork with premium seating along with the company's AI tools daily, deeply and natively — not as a novelty, but as the default way you work.

     

    We operate in a fast-moving startup environment where speed and precision both matter. You must be opinionated about which QA tasks AI does well today (test-case generation, coverage analysis, log triage), which it does not (exploratory judgment, UX intuition, risk feel) — and how to combine both deliberately.

     

    What you will own & do

     

    AI-First Way of Working

    • Daily, deep, native use of AI tools for test-case generation from specs, coverage gap analysis, bug report drafting, log and session triage, regression checklist upkeep.

    • Treat AI tools the way an engineer treats their IDE: opinionated, tuned, integrated into every step of your workflow.

    • Contribute to internal evals from the QA side: define what “good” looks like for AI-generated code, AI-generated test artifacts and our user-facing AI features.

     

    Manual Testing & Test Design

    • Own manual testing end to end: exploratory sessions, spec & story-based test design, edge cases, negative paths, cross-role and multi-tenant scenarios.

    • Convert machine-readable specs & stories with acceptance criteria into structured, traceable test cases and checklists — every requirement maps to a verification.

    • Run deep exploratory testing where scripted coverage ends: real-world flows, messy data, weird devices, impatient users.

    • Verify complex B2B2C surfaces: dashboards, role-based access, real-time data, payment flows, document generation, back-office tooling.

     

    Testing AI-Driven Behaviour

    • Test the non-deterministic layer: agent conversations, autonomously generated compliance documents — correctness, groundedness, tone, failure modes.

    • Design and run structured evaluation of LLM outputs with the Analyst and engineering: treat AI output as something to be measured, not trusted.

    • Hunt for hallucinations, prompt-injection surfaces, permission leaks across tenants and roles, and silent agent failures.

     

    Quality Process & Release Ownership

    • Own release readiness: regression scope, smoke passes, UAT coordination with stakeholders, GO/NO-GO input for every release.

    • Write bug reports engineers (and agents) can act on without a follow-up question: environment, steps, expected vs actual, evidence, severity.

    • Feed spec & story defects back upstream: when the work item is wrong or ambiguous, it gets fixed at the spec/story layer, not patched in QA.

    • Build the QA practice from scratch: process, tooling, test data, defect workflow in Jira — lightweight enough for startup speed, rigorous enough to trust.

     

    What we are looking for

     

    Must have

     4+ years of hands-on manual QA experience on web products, with senior-level ownership of quality for a product or major product area.

    • 0 → 1 builder: comfortable being the first and only QA, setting up the practice yourself, working directly with founders and engineering — not joining an already-scaled QA org.

    • Experience testing LLM-based features, chatbots, RAG systems or agent workflows — including designing evals or output rubrics.

    • Daily, deep, native use of AI tools in your QA workflow: test generation, triage, analysis, documentation. You have a real, opinionated workflow built around them and can defend your choices.

    • Excellent test design craft: from acceptance criteria to test cases, edge cases, negative scenarios and risk-based prioritization — structured, traceable, unambiguous.

    • Strong exploratory testing instincts: you find the bugs no script would — and can explain how you found them.

    • Sharp written bug reporting and strong verbal communication in English (C1+), under startup timelines, without losing rigor.

    • Comfortable with complex B2B / multi-sided product surfaces: multi-tenant SaaS, role-based access, real-time data, payments, back-office tooling.

     Working knowledge of APIs and databases for verification: reading API responses (Postman or similar), basic SQL to check data behind the UI, reading logs.

     

    Strong advantage (Nice to have)

    • Background in PropTech, hospitality tech, Fintech or multi-sided marketplace platforms.

    • Exposure to payment flows, compliance / regulatory workflows or document-generation systems.

    • Test automation literacy (Playwright, Cypress or similar) — enough to direct agents that write automation, even if you don't write it daily.

     

    Why this role

    You will help build the first AI-native operating system for real estate in Dubai and define what quality means when AI agents write most of the code. Both are differentiators, both are hard and both are yours to own at the senior level.

     

    • Genuine quality ownership — you build the QA practice from zero and hold the release bar. This is not a “execute someone else's test cases” role.

    • Clear growth trajectory — this role evolves into AI-First QA Lead / Head of Quality as the team scales.

    • Direct access to founders and Head of Delivery & Product — short decision loops, no middle management.

    • Technically ambitious product surface  AI-native, Agentic system, RAG, IoT, real-time systems, government and regulatory APIs and eventually tokenization infrastructure.

     AI-first by default — you will co-design how quality assurance works inside an AI-first delivery machine.

    • Great office in the centre of Kyiv — one on-site team, short feedback loops, fast decisions.

    Benefits:

    Work from home, flexible hours

    Be a key member of a small team

    Fast paced startup environment, global team

    Get things done while having fun

    Help real people succeed in business

    Get rewards and bonuses for working hard

    Compensation in USD

    Unlimited days off

     

     

    Responsibilities:

    Own the manual testing process for our web-based lending platform, from reviewing requirements through to release sign-off

    Write clear, comprehensive test plans, test cases and checklists based on user stories and acceptance criteria

    Execute functional, regression, smoke and exploratory testing across browsers and mobile web

    Use AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot and similar) to draft and expand test cases, generate test data and speed up bug reproduction, then apply your own judgement to verify what the AI produces

    Validate data end to end, including API responses (Postman or similar) and database checks with basic SQL

    Identify, reproduce, document and track defects in Jira with clear steps, evidence and severity

    Perform thorough regression testing before each release and keep the regression suite current

    Partner with our CTO, developers and automation engineers to flag risk early and suggest which cases are worth automating

    Contribute to QA process improvement: test coverage, test data, environments and release checklists

    2+ years of hands-on manual QA experience testing web applications

    Solid grasp of QA methodologies and test design techniques (equivalence partitioning, boundary values, decision tables), test levels and the defect lifecycle

    Proven ability to write clear, concise and comprehensive test plans and test cases

    Experience with API testing (Postman or similar) and reading API documentation

    Basic SQL - able to query and validate data yourself

    Comfortable with browser developer tools (console, network tab, responsive mode) for triage

    Experience with a bug tracker (Jira) and a test management tool (TestRail, Xray, Zephyr or similar)

    Practical experience using AI assistants in day-to-day QA work, plus the judgement to verify their output and to keep confidential data out of public tools

    Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail - able to spot edge cases in complex business logic and calculations

    Experience working in an Agile/Scrum process in close collaboration with developers

    Self-starter who can own quality with minimal supervision in a fully remote setup

     

    Nice to Have:

    Exposure to fintech, lending, banking or mortgage products

    Experience testing AI or LLM-powered features - non-deterministic output, prompt regression, accuracy and hallucination checks

    Familiarity with test automation (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium) - enough to read, run and triage automated tests

    Experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or similar) and testing in staging environments

    Basics of accessibility or performance testing

    ISTQB certification or equivalent

    Previous experience with international or US-based teams

     

    How We Use AI Here:

    AI is part of how we work, not a replacement for thinking. You will be encouraged to use AI tools to move faster - drafting test cases, generating realistic test data, summarising regression results and exploring edge cases you might otherwise miss.

    What we expect in return is accountability for the result: verify what the model gives you, keep customer and company data out of public tools, and tell us when AI is not the right tool for the job.

    If you have not used AI much in QA yet but are curious and quick to learn, that is fine - we will help you get there.

     

    Hiring Process:

    Intro call, a short practical QA exercise based on a real scenario from our product, a technical interview with our CTO and a pre-employment assessment. We aim to keep the whole process inside two weeks.

    We work hard, days can be long, but we get rewarded for it

    We are available and responsive

    We think ahead, but we get things done quickly

    We move fast, but try not to break things

    Senior Manual QA Engineer (Mobile / API / Web)

    Location: Ukraine / Remote
    Experience Level: Senior (4+ years)
    Core Skills: Mobile Testing (iOS/Android), API Testing, Web Testing, UI Validation, English C1

    The Opportunity

    Join our FinTech/Trading team as a Senior Manual QA Engineer and help ensure the reliability, accuracy, and usability of a high-performance trading platform.

    You will test complex financial workflows across native iOS and Android applications, Web interfaces, APIs, and backend integrations. The role requires strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and the ability to identify edge cases in systems where correctness, real-time data, and financial accuracy are critical.

    Your Role and Impact

    • Mobile & Web Testing: Perform functional, regression, exploratory, usability, and compatibility testing across native iOS/Android applications and Web platforms.
    • API & Backend Validation: Test REST APIs using tools such as Postman and Swagger/OpenAPI, validate request/response data, error handling, authentication, and client-server interactions.
    • Trading & Financial Flows: Validate complex business logic, financial calculations, order lifecycles, balances, positions, transaction states, and real-time data updates.
    • UI Validation: Verify implementation against Figma/design specifications, including layout, spacing, typography, responsiveness, and Pixel Perfect requirements.
    • Debugging & Investigation: Analyze application logs, browser/network traffic, API responses, and other technical data to identify and isolate defects.
    • Test Documentation: Create and maintain Test Plans, Test Cases, Checklists, and other QA documentation appropriate to the feature and risk level.
    • Defect Management: Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects in Jira, providing clear reproduction steps, supporting evidence, logs, and technical details.
    • Agile Collaboration: Work closely with Developers, Product Owners, Business Analysts, and other QA Engineers to refine requirements, identify risks early, and participate in solution discussions.
    • Quality Ownership: Proactively identify product risks, edge cases, inconsistencies, and areas where testing processes can be improved.

    What You Bring

    • 4+ years of hands-on Manual QA experience, including significant experience testing both Mobile and Web applications.
    • Strong practical experience testing native iOS and Android applications on real devices and emulators/simulators.
    • Strong knowledge of API testing, including Postman collections, environments, authentication, request/response validation, and Swagger/OpenAPI.
    • Strong knowledge of Browser DevTools, including Network, Console, Storage/Application, and debugging client-server interactions.
    • Experience with cross-browser and cross-device testing.
    • Ability to analyze complex business requirements and translate them into effective test scenarios.
    • Strong exploratory-testing skills and the ability to identify non-obvious edge cases.
    • Experience investigating defects using logs, network traffic, API responses, and other available diagnostic information.
    • Experience with Firebase tools such as Crashlytics and App Distribution.
    • Strong attention to UI details and experience validating interfaces against design specifications.
    • Experience working with Jira or similar issue-tracking systems.
    • English level B2 or higher.

    📋 Role Overview

    We’re looking for a Middle QA Engineer to join our team working on a humanitarian transparency platform.

    You’ll work closely with the QA Lead and the product team, combining manual testing with test automation. You’ll help maintain and improve QA processes, ensure reliable releases, and test web applications, APIs, and integrations between services. Part of the platform's data is also shared with a companion service through its own APIs — from a testing perspective, this is treated like any other backend integration: verifying request/response contracts and data consistency between services, not specialized protocol-level work.
     

    🧙‍♂️In this role, you will

    • Build the QA process from scratch together with the QA Lead — test strategy, documentation, tooling.
    • Perform functional, regression, exploratory, and cross-browser testing.
    • Build and maintain automated tests for key regression and smoke scenarios.
    • Report, verify, and track defects through resolution.
    • Verify APIs via DevTools / Postman — payload, response, status codes, error handling.
    • Create and maintain QA documentation: test plans, checklists, test cases, regression reports, release notes.
    • Document your work and support knowledge sharing within the team.
    • Plan and run release regression cycles, prioritize coverage by risk under the timebox.
    • Test integration points between the platform and other backend services it exchanges data with — request/response contracts, data consistency across the API boundary, and how failures/retries are handled.
    • Extend existing API test coverage to new services and endpoints as they're added, verifying that data passed between services arrives complete and unchanged.

     

    🎯You may be interested if

    • You want to be truly responsible for quality on the product, not just execute tasks — building the QA process and keeping it in shape as the platform evolves.
    • You're comfortable working across both manual and automated testing.
    • You take ownership of quality end-to-end, not just finding bugs.
    • You enjoy setting up QA processes and documentation from scratch.
    • You're excited to collaborate in a remote, cross-functional environment.
    • You value autonomy, clear communication, and working in a supportive, small-team setting.

     

    👌 Role Requirements

    • 2–3+ years of experience in QA for web applications.
    • Strong manual testing skills: functional, regression, exploratory.
    • Hands-on experience with test automation (Playwright, pytest, or similar).
    • API testing experience (Postman or similar).
    • Confident with browser DevTools.
    • Ability to work independently within agreed priorities and escalate risks early.
    • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery methodology.
    • Experience creating and maintaining QA documentation (test plans, checklists, reports).
    • Familiarity with data-heavy interfaces.
    • English proficiency at B2 level or higher.

     

    Nice to have:

    • Experience testing PWA or mobile web applications.
    • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and integrating tests into them.
    • Experience with performance or load testing basics.
    • Experience with security testing basics.
    • Background in projects involving data-heavy or dashboard-style interfaces.
    • Experience organizing test cases in a test-case management system (e.g., QA Sphere, TestRail, or similar).
    • Exposure to blockchain/Web3 concepts is a plus, not required.

     

    💻 Working Conditions

    • Employment Type: Full-Time
    • This is a fully remote position with the entire team across Ukraine.
    • 20 working days of paid vacation per year.
    • The team collaboratively defines deadlines, ensuring a balanced and manageable workload. The focus is on delivering commitments on time.
    • People over process — we have structure, but we don't let it get in the way of common sense.
    • Transparency — we build a transparency platform, and we operate the same way internally. No hidden agendas, no politics.
    • Quality as a culture, not a checkbox — we believe quality is everyone's responsibility, and you'll be driving it day to day together with the QA Lead.
